subject: Asteria Health — security questionnaire path and evidence checklist
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.t@asteriahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-15T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick follow-up & proposed path for security questionnaire

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our side and a proposed path so we can get your security team what they need without slowing the deal down:

1) Primary asks we heard from your security intake: SOC 2 Type II evidence (scope: hosted inference & telemetry), GDPR data residency for EU customers, and basic KMS/HSM details. You also flagged wanting an initial CAIQ/SSM-type prefill to speed review.

2) Proposed path: we can deliver a CAIQ-prefill + a one-page SOC 2 summary (control scope, auditor, controls in-scope, last audit date). If you need deeper artifacts (audit report, tech evidence), Marissa can coordinate packaged evidence and an SSO-enabled read-only Drive link.

3) Timeline suggestion: CAIQ prefill in 3 business days, SOC 2 one-pager same week, evidence bundle within 7–10 business days after we confirm scope and owners. If you prefer SIG-lite (smaller questionnaire) we can map answers to that instead.

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm whether CAIQ or SIG (full) is preferred.
- Confirm whether Asteria needs EU-only hosting for production or for PII test data as well.
- Provide preferred evidence delivery mechanism (DocuSign/secure Drive/ShareFile).

I’ve attached a short SOC 2 summary and our CAIQ-prefill template to this thread to give your team a head start. Marissa — can you confirm expected owner-level evidence we'll need (e.g., encryption-at-rest HLD, KMS diagram, BAA draft)? Rishi — looping you for any legal redline constraints on sharing parts of the SOC report.

Happy to jump on a short call with your security lead if that moves things faster.

Best,
Jordan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0129

Attachments: redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf (PDF summary), caig-prefill-template.xlsx (prefill worksheet)
From: Elena Torres <elena.t@asteriahealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Asteria Health Security <security@asteriahealth.com>
Date: 2026-07-16T09:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up & proposed path for security questionnaire

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifying Qs from our security team before we pick a route:

- SOC 2: we need to confirm whether Redwood is willing to provide an auditor-signed SOC 2 Type II (if not the full report, at minimum the auditor name, coverage dates, and description of excluded systems). Is that possible?

- Residency: For now, we require EU data residency for all production customer data. Test data used in POCs can remain in Redwood hosted regions (US) if flagged. Is there a straightforward way to show your runtime region mappings?

- Questionnaire choice: CAIQ-prefill sounds fine — we can start there. If the CAIQ prefill shows gaps, we will request SIG (full).

- Evidence delivery: Secure Drive link preferred. If you can create per-artifact access controls (read-only link for our auditors), that would be ideal.

Can Marissa or Rishi confirm the SOC/doc sharing constraints? Also please copy any BAA template if available.

Thanks,
Elena Torres
Head of Security Operations | Asteria Health
elena.t@asteriahealth.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.t@asteriahealth.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-16T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up & proposed path for security questionnaire

Hi Elena —

Appreciate the questions; short answers and concrete next steps below.

1) SOC 2: Redwood maintains a SOC 2 Type II for our hosted service (scope: inference control plane and telemetry ingestion pipelines). We typically provide a redacted report to customers under an NDA. For procurement cadence, we can provide: auditor name, coverage window, testing period, and a one-page control summary immediately. If your auditors need the full report we can arrange secure sharing after an NDA; let us know the auditor contact and expected delivery window.

2) Residency: We support EU-hosted inference nodes in AWS eu-west-1 and GCP europe-west2. We can provide a diagram of runtime region routing and a short note on data-at-rest residency for customer-controlled buckets. For POCs we recommend enabling the EU region flag to provision test nodes in-region — I’ll include a runtime mapping doc in the evidence bundle.

3) CAIQ vs SIG: Start with the CAIQ-prefill. I’ll complete the worksheet Jordan attached and flag any gaps that would trigger a SIG. We can also provide a SIG-lite mapping to expedite the review.

4) Evidence delivery: secure Drive link with artifact-level permissions works; we can also provide a read-only auditor link (time-limited) for SOC report access. BAA: we do have a standard BAA template — I’m attaching the BAA checklist in the evidence bundle and will share the template once you confirm interest.

Owners & timeline:
- Marissa: evidence bundle + runtime mapping doc — ETA 3 business days for CAIQ-prefill + SOC one-pager.
- Jordan: coordinate with procurement and confirm whether a redacted SOC report + NDA will be acceptable if auditors request it.
- Rishi (legal): can you confirm any constraints on sharing full SOC materials and whether the standard BAA requires legal review before sending?

Elena — if that works I’ll queue the CAIQ-prefill today and share the Drive link when ready.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: (will include runtime-mapping.pdf, BAA_template.docx in the Drive bundle when shared)
From: Elena Torres <elena.t@asteriahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-18T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up & proposed path for security questionnaire

Marissa — thanks, that proposed path sounds good. A few final clarifications before we start:

- Please include the runtime mapping doc (region-to-service mapping) in the initial bundle so our infra folks can verify the EU host locations.
- We will accept a redacted SOC 2 under NDA; I will loop our procurement and legal and send over an NDA template if needed.
- Please attach your standard BAA template with the bundle — our legal prefers to start redlines early.

We’re happy to start with the CAIQ-prefill. Once we review it, we’ll escalate to SIG only for any control gaps. Please send the Drive link and a short checklist of the artifacts you’ll include.

I’ll schedule a 30-min sync with our security engineer and procurement for Thursday if that helps.

Thanks — looking forward to the bundle.

Elena
-- end of thread --
